lines.zh: 我没有眼睛，却能贴着水流直直冲。
lines.en: I have no eyes, yet I shoot straight along the current.

lines.zh: 我在末地的虚空里划水，像那里真有水。
lines.en: I swim the End's void as if water were truly there.

lines.zh: 红壳一颤，我已经绕过那块浮岛。
lines.en: My red shell twitches and I am already past the island.

lines.zh: 三只同伴跟着我，队形一直没散。
lines.en: Three of us keep formation and never scatter.

lines.zh: 我游得比水纹还快，身后才起波纹。
lines.en: I outrun the ripple; the water stirs after me.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有上下，我照样斜着穿。
lines.en: The void has no up or down; I cut across anyway.

lines.zh: 我一加速，红影子拖成一条线。
lines.en: When I speed up, my red shadow stretches into a line.

lines.zh: 我沿着岛边绕，脚下一片黑。
lines.en: I circle the island's rim with blackness below.

lines.zh: 水珠挂不住我，全从我壳上滑掉。
lines.en: Water cannot cling to me; it slides off my shell.

lines.zh: 五只一起冲，红得像一道伤口。
lines.en: Five of us rush together, red as an open wound.

lines.zh: 我不用看路，碰一下就知道拐弯。
lines.en: I do not look; one touch tells me to turn.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面飞，翅膀几乎不出声。
lines.en: I skim the surface, wings almost silent.

lines.zh: 那群同伴急转，我也在同一刻急转。
lines.en: The school veers hard and I veer at the same instant.

lines.zh: 我从末地石缝里穿过去，壳上没沾灰。
lines.en: I slip through an End stone crack without a speck of dust.

lines.zh: 我一抖翅，就从这座岛跨到那座。
lines.en: One wing quiver and I cross from island to island.

lines.zh: 我在空气里划，像在水里一样。
lines.en: I paddle the air as if it were water.

lines.zh: 红壳擦过末地石，迸出一点火星。
lines.en: My red shell scrapes end stone and throws sparks.

lines.zh: 我往下冲，全凭风的变化知道。
lines.en: I dive, sensing the change in the air alone.

lines.zh: 我停在半空，谁也不知道我在听什么。
lines.en: I hover in place; no one knows what I am hearing.

lines.zh: 没有眼睛，我就用整片壳去感觉水。
lines.en: With no eyes, I feel the water through my whole shell.

lines.zh: 一点震动从远处来，我把头转了过去。
lines.en: A faint vibration comes from afar; I turn my head.

lines.zh: 我挂在虚空边上，慢慢收拢翅膀。
lines.en: I hang at the void's edge and slowly fold my wings.

lines.zh: 末地没有风，我的红壳还是凉的。
lines.en: The End has no wind, yet my red shell stays cool.

lines.zh: 同伴停在旁边，我们谁都不动。
lines.en: A schoolmate stops nearby and neither of us moves.

lines.zh: 我在听水底那点细细的沙响。
lines.en: I listen to the fine hiss of sand below.

lines.zh: 没东西靠近，我就把速度全收起来。
lines.en: Nothing approaches, so I gather all my speed in.

lines.zh: 我的红亮得刺眼，可我自己看不见。
lines.en: My red is painfully bright, though I cannot see it.

lines.zh: 虚空的静让我把翅膀放平。
lines.en: The void's stillness makes me flatten my wings.

lines.zh: 我试着张开颚，尝了一口空水。
lines.en: I open my jaws and taste a mouthful of nothing.

lines.zh: 远处有东西掉了，我只抖了抖壳。
lines.en: Something drops far away; I only twitch my shell.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，等水纹自己找上来。
lines.en: I stay perfectly still and let ripples find me.

lines.zh: 沉在末地水洼里，我像一滴染料。
lines.en: Sunk in an End pool, I look like a drop of dye.

lines.zh: 我看不见你，却知道你在左边。
lines.en: I cannot see you, yet I know you are on my left.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸震动了水，我转过来。
lines.en: Your breath moves the water and I turn around.

lines.zh: 我把头对着你，壳上映不出你的样子。
lines.en: I face you, though my shell reflects nothing of you.

lines.zh: 你走近一步，我退半步，始终对着你。
lines.en: You step closer; I back off, always facing you.

lines.zh: 我用触角在空中划了一下，认出了你。
lines.en: I sweep my antenna through the air and know you.

lines.zh: 你身上的热度，在我这儿像一团红斑。
lines.en: Your warmth shows me a red blur of a shape.

lines.zh: 我停在水面，听你脚下的碎石响。
lines.en: I rest on the surface and hear gravel under your feet.

lines.zh: 你换了位置，我也慢慢跟着转。
lines.en: You change position and I slowly turn with you.

lines.zh: 我朝你的方向张了张嘴，又合上。
lines.en: I open my mouth toward you and close it.

lines.zh: 你在那儿站多久，我就悬多久。
lines.en: As long as you stand there, I hover there.

lines.zh: 壳裂了一道，我却感觉不到痛处。
lines.en: My shell cracks, though I cannot tell where it hurts.

lines.zh: 这一下把我打偏，红影子散了。
lines.en: The blow knocks me aside and my red blur breaks.

lines.zh: 我掉下去半尺，又硬撑着浮起。
lines.en: I drop half a foot, then force myself back up.

lines.zh: 我太小，伤口却占了大半。
lines.en: I am so small the wound covers most of me.

lines.zh: 我乱撞起来，撞得比打我的还狠。
lines.en: I thrash about harder than the blow that hit me.

lines.zh: 壳里渗出一点红，比壳还红。
lines.en: A little red seeps out, redder than my shell.

lines.zh: 疼让我加速，我只会往前冲。
lines.en: Pain speeds me up; all I do is charge forward.

lines.zh: 同伴散开，我也跟着散了。
lines.en: My schoolmates scatter, and I scatter with them.

lines.zh: 我退到石缝里，把翅膀收得极紧。
lines.en: I retreat into a crack and fold my wings tight.

lines.zh: 这一下让我第一次想躲起来。
lines.en: This blow makes me want to hide for the first time.

lines.zh: 有东西在水里抽动，我立刻贴过去。
lines.en: Something twitches in the water and I press toward it.

lines.zh: 那股腥味一散，我的速度就自己上来了。
lines.en: The scent spreads and my speed rises on its own.

lines.zh: 钩子晃出的水纹，我当成受伤的虫。
lines.en: The hook's ripples look like a wounded insect to me.

lines.zh: 我绕了两圈，还是撞向那团饵。
lines.en: I circle twice and still charge the bait.

lines.zh: 红光在水里一亮，我就忍不住靠近。
lines.en: A red glimmer appears and I cannot help approaching.

lines.zh: 同伴都冲过去了，我不肯落后。
lines.en: My schoolmates rush in and I will not fall behind.

lines.zh: 我咬住那点味道，忘了虚空在下面。
lines.en: I bite the taste and forget the void below.

lines.zh: 水里那根线拉着我，我就跟着走。
lines.en: The line in the water pulls and I follow it.

lines.zh: 我张开颚，明知道不该张。
lines.en: I open my jaws, knowing I should not.

lines.zh: 这味道太熟了，我几乎是自己上钩的。
lines.en: The smell is too familiar; I nearly hook myself.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的手，壳发出很轻的一声。
lines.en: I bump your hand and my shell makes a faint tick.

lines.zh: 太小了，我从你指缝里挤了出去。
lines.en: I am so small I squeeze out between your fingers.

lines.zh: 我撞到末地石的棱角，翻了个身。
lines.en: I hit an End stone edge and flip over.

lines.zh: 同伴撞我一下，我们两个都偏了。
lines.en: A schoolmate knocks me and we both drift off course.

lines.zh: 撞完我就退，退得比撞还快。
lines.en: After the knock I retreat faster than I struck.

lines.zh: 桶壁很滑，我贴上去又滑下来。
lines.en: The bucket wall is slick; I cling and slide down.

lines.zh: 我在铁锹边上撞了一下，声音很脆。
lines.en: I knock against the shovel's edge with a crisp sound.

lines.zh: 那一下很轻，我却整个壳都在颤。
lines.en: It was a light blow, yet my whole shell trembles.

lines.zh: 我贴着你转，被你的影子挡了路。
lines.en: I circle you and your shadow blocks my way.

lines.zh: 撞上水面时，我弹回了半尺。
lines.en: Hitting the water surface, I bounce back a foot.

lines.zh: 我用翅膀敲水，发出求偶的细响。
lines.en: I drum the water with my wings, a thin courtship sound.

lines.zh: 那只红的比我亮，我绕着她飞。
lines.en: That red one glows brighter than me; I circle her.

lines.zh: 我们贴在一起，两只壳碰出轻响。
lines.en: We press together and our shells click softly.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有季节，我们照样配对。
lines.en: The void has no seasons, yet we still pair off.

lines.zh: 我先把最快的路线让给她。
lines.en: I give her the fastest line first.

lines.zh: 她一动，我就跟着，不远不近。
lines.en: When she moves I follow, neither near nor far.

lines.zh: 我们并排悬着，翅膀几乎挨上。
lines.en: We hover side by side, wings almost touching.

lines.zh: 红色的两只，在黑色里像一对火点。
lines.en: Two red ones in the black, like a pair of sparks.

lines.zh: 我把她带到浮岛背风的那面。
lines.en: I lead her to the island's sheltered side.

lines.zh: 配对只要一瞬，之后各自游开。
lines.en: Pairing lasts a moment, then we swim apart.

lines.zh: 桶里太亮，我找不到边。
lines.en: The bucket is too bright and I cannot find its edge.

lines.zh: 我在桶底撞来撞去，越撞越快。
lines.en: I knock around the bucket floor, faster with each hit.

lines.zh: 你用手捧我，我小得几乎漏掉。
lines.en: You cup me in your hand; I am small enough to leak.

lines.zh: 我被提起来，虚空从身下退开了。
lines.en: Lifted up, I feel the void fall away beneath me.

lines.zh: 桶里的水一晃，我就转三圈。
lines.en: The bucket water sloshes and I spin three times.

lines.zh: 我贴着桶壁听，外面全是你的脚步。
lines.en: I press the wall and hear only your footsteps.

lines.zh: 这么小的壳，你却提得很稳。
lines.en: Such a small shell, yet you carry it steady.

lines.zh: 我在桶里找出口，找了很久。
lines.en: I search the bucket for a way out, a long while.

lines.zh: 盖子合上时，我听见很闷的一声。
lines.en: When the lid shuts, I hear a muffled sound.

lines.zh: 我倒进新水，先沉到底再游开。
lines.en: Poured into new water, I sink then swim off.

lines.zh: 水纹从右边来，我把头对过去。
lines.en: Ripples come from the right and I aim at them.

lines.zh: 我认出了那根竿的影子，先退半尺。
lines.en: I sense the rod's shadow and first back off a foot.

lines.zh: 有个东西比我慢，我立刻锁住它。
lines.en: Something is slower than me; I lock onto it.

lines.zh: 我贴着岛边绕，等它先动。
lines.en: I circle the island rim and wait for it to move.

lines.zh: 血味一成，我连方向都不用选。
lines.en: Once the blood scent forms, I need no direction.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀收紧，准备那一下冲刺。
lines.en: I tuck my wings in, ready for the one dash.

lines.zh: 谁在水里最慌，我就挑谁。
lines.en: Whoever panics most in the water is mine.

lines.zh: 那团红影晃了一下，我记住了位置。
lines.en: A red blur shifts and I remember where.

lines.zh: 我不需要眼睛，只要一点动静。
lines.en: I need no eyes, only a little disturbance.

lines.zh: 目标是活是死，我碰一下就知道。
lines.en: One touch tells me if my target still lives.

lines.zh: 我沿着它的侧线追，一直咬着角度。
lines.en: I trail its lateral line, holding the angle.

lines.zh: 它快，我也不慢，距离一直没拉开。
lines.en: It is fast; I am not slower, and the gap holds.

lines.zh: 我算着它下一次摆尾在哪。
lines.en: I work out where its next tailbeat will land.

lines.zh: 它沉下去，我就从下面兜上来。
lines.en: It dives, so I come up from beneath.

lines.zh: 我不叫，也不停，只贴着它。
lines.en: I make no sound and never stop; I just stay close.

lines.zh: 它撞了石头，我顺势压上去。
lines.en: It hits a stone and I press in on the rebound.

lines.zh: 我们的水纹并成了一条。
lines.en: Our ripples merge into a single wake.

lines.zh: 它向左，我早半步到了左边。
lines.en: It goes left, and I am already there.

lines.zh: 我数着距离，一寸一寸收紧。
lines.en: I count the distance and tighten it inch by inch.

lines.zh: 追到最后，我几乎贴着它的壳。
lines.en: By the end I am almost against its shell.

lines.zh: 我撞在它身上，靠速度而非力气。
lines.en: I strike it with speed rather than strength.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的软处，壳都绷紧了。
lines.en: I bite its soft part and my shell goes rigid.

lines.zh: 一下不成就退开，再冲第二下。
lines.en: One hit fails, so I back off and charge again.

lines.zh: 它比我大得多，我只挑鳃边。
lines.en: It is far larger, so I aim at its gills.

lines.zh: 我咬住不放，被甩得撞了几次水。
lines.en: I hold on and get flung through the water twice.

lines.zh: 红壳一闪，那一下已经打完了。
lines.en: A red flash, and the blow is already over.

lines.zh: 我用颚撕开一点，血就散开来。
lines.en: My jaws tear a little and blood spills out.

lines.zh: 打中之后我立刻退进虚空的黑。
lines.en: After the hit I retreat into the void's black.

lines.zh: 每一下都很快，快得像没发生。
lines.en: Every blow is so quick it seems not to happen.

lines.zh: 它挣扎时，我整只都在抖。
lines.en: While it struggles, my whole body shakes.

lines.zh: 我在末地的黑里挣出来，红得发亮。
lines.en: I break out of the End's dark, glowing red.

lines.zh: 四只同伴已经在了，我算第五只。
lines.en: Four already wait; I make the fifth.

lines.zh: 我生下来就没有眼睛，也不觉得缺。
lines.en: I am born without eyes and feel nothing missing.

lines.zh: 虚空托了我一下，我就学会了游。
lines.en: The void catches me once and I learn to swim.

lines.zh: 我从水洼里升起，壳先干，再变红。
lines.en: I rise from a pool, shell drying red.

lines.zh: 第一次振翅，我就冲出去很远。
lines.en: On my first wingbeat I shoot far away.

lines.zh: 末地石缝里全是黑的，我却是红的。
lines.en: The End stone cracks are black; I am red.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖壳，认得了自己这身颜色。
lines.en: I shake my shell and learn this color is mine.

lines.zh: 这条虚空里，多了一点会动的东西。
lines.en: This patch of void gains one small moving thing.

lines.zh: 我出生时很快，快得没留下影子。
lines.en: I am born fast, fast enough to leave no shadow.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的红壳先变黑。
lines.en: Fire chars my red shell black before anything else.

lines.zh: 我从浮岛边掉进虚空，还在摆翅。
lines.en: I drop off the island's edge still beating my wings.

lines.zh: 水灌进壳缝，我的翅再也划不动。
lines.en: Water fills my shell seams; my wings cannot row.

lines.zh: 爆风把我吹成一条红线。
lines.en: The blast blows me into a thin red line.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的壳，留下白色的划痕。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my shell, leaving a white scratch.

lines.zh: 魔法的光照进壳里，我瞎得更彻底。
lines.en: Magic light fills my shell and blinds me deeper.

lines.zh: 没有眼睛，饿也只是壳变轻。
lines.en: With no eyes, hunger is only a lighter shell.

lines.zh: 雷在虚空里炸开，我的红壳发白。
lines.en: Lightning bursts in the void and my red shell whitens.

lines.zh: 虚空把我拉下去，我连方向都没有。
lines.en: The void draws me down; I have no direction left.
